g.text: Five colors out of one print
Katsushika Hokusai, Under the Wave off Kanagawa,
c. 1830–32. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.
Sampled in this order: the largest area first, then
the darkest, then the lightest, then two accents
chosen for meaning rather than area.
Five samples. Not a palette — nothing measured.
Artwork provenance: The Metropolitan Museum of Art (Open Access, CC0) · this impression via Wikimedia Commons
